# PITFALL CAVE (TEST) -- the drawing half, for tests/js_unit.js.
#
# Synthetic, like the rest of the Pitfall Cave fixture: the station
# names tie to testdata/PitfallCave.svx, and the scrap coordinates are
# a made-up sketching grid at roughly 2 scrap units to the foot.
#
# It is written to exercise the reader rather than to look like a cave:
# every construct CsTherion2 claims to read appears once, and so does
# every construct it claims to refuse.
##XTHERION## xth_me_area_adjust 0 -900 1300 0
##XTHERION## xth_me_area_zoom_to 100
##XTHERION## xth_me_image_insert {0 1 1.0} {0 {}} pitfall-page-3.jpg 0 {}

input other-half.th2

scrap plan1 -projection plan -scale [0 0 100 0 0.0 0.0 50.0 0.0 ft]

	point 0 0 station -name A1
	point -28 -50 station -name A2
	point -74 -97 station -name A3
	point -112 -128 station -name A5

	point -40 -30 stalactite -orientation 45 -scale l
	point -60 -70 stalagmite
	point -20 -18 entrance
	point -95 -110 altitude -value 684.6
	point -130 -150 continuation -text "GOES, TOO TIGHT FOR DAVE"
	point -50 -95 label -text "THE PINCH"
	point -70 -20 u:bolt-hanger
	point -80 -100 section -scrap xs1

	line wall -id leftwall
		10 -6
		-18 -44
		-30 -58 -46 -74 -64 -90
		-100 -120
	endline

	line wall -subtype presumed
		-100 -120
		-140 -170
	endline

	line wall -subtype invisible
		-140 -170
		-150 -180
	endline

	line pit
		-70 -92
		-82 -104
		-90 -118
		-close on
	endline

	line border -id pool
		-30 -60
		-46 -64
		-50 -80
		-34 -78
		-close on
	endline

	line survey
		0 0
		-28 -50
	endline

	line u:handline
		-12 -8
		-20 -30
	endline

	area water
		line pool
	endarea

endscrap

scrap ext1 -projection extended -scale [0 0 100 0 0.0 0.0 50.0 0.0 ft]
	point 0 0 station -name A1
	point 60 -12 station -name A2
	point 128 -30 station -name A3
	line wall
		0 20
		60 14
		128 8
	endline
	line floor-step
		60 -20
		128 -34
	endline
endscrap

scrap xs1 -projection none -scale [0 0 40 0 0.0 0.0 10.0 0.0 ft]
	line wall
		-20 -30
		-22 10
		0 24
		22 8
		18 -30
		-close on
	endline
endscrap

scrap elev1 -projection [elevation 90]
	line wall
		0 0
		40 0
	endline
endscrap

scrap odd1 -projection sideways
	line wall
		0 0
		10 10
	endline
endscrap

findings.message: The sketch pins a scanned image behind it. That image is not imported: place it with Sketch Scans, which can fit it on the stations.
This sketch pulls in another file (other-half.th2). Only what is in this file is imported -- open the other file separately.
Scrap "elev1" is a projected elevation. This suite draws an EXTENDED elevation, which is a different drawing of the same cave, so the scrap is not imported.
Scrap "odd1" is drawn in a projection this reader does not know (sideways). It is not imported.
